cocoliztli.reason: Pathogen evidence from one cemetery cannot readily be extended to both waves, and overlapping symptoms permit multiple causes. A convincing attribution would revise explanations of demographic catastrophe in New Spain and guide interpretation of other epidemic accounts and burials.

rongorongo.reason: Even a securely dated piece of wood does not establish when its signs were carved or whether they encoded speech. A convincing result would affect comparative accounts of writing's origins and give the corpus a firmer context for analysis.

shapira-scrolls.reason: Variant sketches and accounts could expose a specific modern source for a reading, but with the strips missing many material tests cannot be replicated. A verdict would settle a consequential disputed biblical witness and clarify the evidentiary standing of its transcriptions.

meroitic.reason: Known sound values and parallel contexts make independently testable readings of some new passages credible, although free translation faces a shortage of bilingual controls. Such gains would recover Kushite testimony beyond epitaphs and give later researchers vocabulary and grammatical checks.

galen-arabic.reason: Distinctive quotations and the translator's descriptions can corroborate the identity of a manuscript even when its title has changed. Recovering lost Galenic material would revise the history of ancient medicine and supply texts for translation, editing and reception studies.

china-1600.reason: Gazetteers can expose stale quotas, but missing wartime households may have fled or fallen outside registration, leaving actual deaths particularly uncertain. Defensible estimates would change accounts of the Ming-Qing transition and support regional comparisons of war and recovery.

beowulf.reason: Metrical and linguistic features constrain periods, but oral transmission, scribal modernization and a single late witness make a narrow composition date difficult. Secure dating would relocate the poem in English political and literary history and anchor comparisons with other verse.

roman-census.reason: Settlement trajectories can check the plausibility of rival readings of the census, but site counts map imperfectly onto people with citizen status. A defensible total would reshape explanations of Augustan enfranchisement and furnish a denominator for Roman military and social history.

medieval-cattle-plagues.reason: Independent dated notices can test the direction of spread, although gaps to the east and ambiguous accounts of animal mortality complicate conclusions for all three plagues. Establishing their routes would clarify livestock exchange and offer a chronology for later epizootic comparisons.

sloane-informants.reason: A label and letter can sometimes trace a distinct piece of knowledge past the named intermediary, though composite entries limit generalization. Identifying particular suppliers would redistribute credit in medical collecting and connect catalogue entries to otherwise dispersed personal histories.

indian-ocean-slave-trade.reason: Deduplicating transfers and voyages can establish substantial minima, but poorly observed local routes leave wide uncertainty in aggregate totals. A convincing estimate would revise the scale and geography of coerced migration and enable comparisons with other slave trades.

gutenberg-type.reason: Recurring details across impressions could distinguish recurring matrices from transient ink effects, yet different casting techniques may leave equivalent printed traces. Resolving the process would refine the history of early typography and give investigators a diagnostic for other workshops.

ibn-battuta.reason: Borrowed prose can establish literary dependence, while a traveller could still have visited the place described. Securely establishing which journeys occurred would change use of the narrative as historical testimony and distinguish firsthand evidence for several regions.

padang-1697.reason: The relative timing and distribution of reported surges could rule out some ruptures, but uncertain water heights and ambiguous coral records may leave several candidates. Identification would fix a regional disaster in the historical record and extend the earthquake sequence used in hazard studies.

kerala-jesuits.reason: A letter naming a text, method and recipient might bridge the traditions, but mathematical priority and missionary contact establish only opportunity. Resolving transmission would change accounts of early calculus and clarify which teaching and translation networks merit study.

silent-film-fragments.reason: A distinctive scene sequence can be checked against contemporary synopses, cast photographs and alternate catalogue titles. Identifications would restore works to particular filmographies and make previously anonymous footage available to numerous studies of performance and production.

indigenous-slavery.reason: Sales and suits provide local minima, but concealed enslavement and repeated sales of the same person create errors in opposite directions across four centuries. A defensible overall range would revise accounts of colonial labor and enable regional demographic comparisons.

toromiro-provenance.reason: A voucher, bed location and accession trail can identify descendants where transfers and propagation are documented, though gaps threaten more distant pedigrees. Establishing which stocks have wild provenance would recover collecting histories and inform conservation and botanical comparisons.

leprosy-americas.reason: Parallel passages allow comparison of named conditions, observable symptoms and treatment in their own textual contexts, with other Nahua uses checking translation choices. An answer would recover distinctions obscured by a Spanish disease label and aid studies of colonial description and diagnosis.

hidden-vocabularies.reason: Page-level searching and comparison of list order and errors can uncover independent vocabularies omitted from existing catalogues. Recoveries would document early encounters and supply primary linguistic evidence for historical linguists and the communities concerned.

ottoman-tahrir.reason: Tracking the same settlements across register changes can distinguish some fiscal relabeling from actual loss, though migration and exemptions complicate regional inference. A credible demographic trend would revise accounts of Ottoman crisis and anchor comparisons of settlement and taxation.

khipu.reason: Associations between cord features and named categories might be verified across a few independently documented examples, but scarce secure pairs constrain a reproducible reading. Reading non-numerical signs would revise accounts of Andean recordkeeping and unlock a dispersed primary archive.

james-pawpaw-remedy.reason: Distinctive shared phrasing could establish descent from Pawpaw's recipe if competing printed versions and manuscript dates can be excluded. Demonstrating anonymous transmission would clarify credit for the remedy and give researchers a traceable example of how Sloane acquired medical knowledge.

early-syphilis.reason: Dating the witness and the events it actually describes can distinguish contemporary outbreak accounts from later recollections, though early terminology is ambiguous. Establishing the earliest secure description would refine the European chronology and supply a point of comparison for other putative cases.

ternate-gingie.reason: The proclamation dates official concern, but growers and smokers would need to surface in independent testimony or enforcement records. Identifying them would recover the social setting of cannabis use on Ternate and connect colonial regulation with local trade and practice.

lost-editions.reason: Successive catalogues and inventories permit estimates stratified by format, but editions with almost no chance of leaving evidence dominate the uncertain tail. A defensible range would change estimates of print output and allow survival corrections in studies of readership and genres.

gregorian-chant.reason: Aligning melodies can show relationships, yet missing early notation makes the direction of descent hard to distinguish from shared inheritance. Resolving it would alter accounts of liturgical transmission and give related chant repertories a better historical reference.

song-iron.reason: Local receipts can constrain output where levy rules are independently known, but alternative collection rates substantially change the extrapolated total. An answer would revise the scale of Song industry and anchor studies of its labor, fuel and transport requirements.

irish-1641.reason: Place, time and named victims allow many duplicate reports to be recognized, though sparse coverage of some communities complicates upper bounds. A defensible death toll would recalibrate accounts of the rising and provide a local framework for studying displacement and commemoration.

borneo-elephants.reason: Court elephants in Java establish one link at most, and even a documented gift would require evidence that its descendants account for the Borneo population. Resolving origin would clarify royal animal transfers and inform comparisons of island conservation histories.

dunhuang-fragments.reason: Complementary torn edges, fiber patterns, handwriting and continuous text can corroborate physical joins across collections. Confirmed joins restore manuscripts and their original settings, giving many linguistic, religious and material studies more complete witnesses.

hittite-fragments.reason: Distinctive matching passages can identify parallel copies, and images of compatible breaks and layout can test physical joins in the photographed subset. Recovering texts and tablet groupings would expand the usable Hittite corpus for philology and historical reconstruction.

mendel.reason: Statistical agreement can be quantified under explicit stopping and classification rules, but several such rules could produce the published pattern. Explaining it would change accounts of Mendel's experimental practice and improve the basis for analyzing other historical datasets.

renaissance-lute.reason: A surviving vocal part can check how faithfully particular arrangers transferred lines, making recovery persuasive where several witnesses agree. Identifications would restore details of specific songs and give editors and performers material for further reconstructions.

gunpowder.reason: Chronologically ordered texts constrain possible transmission routes, but actual carriers and intermediate witnesses are hard to document. A demonstrated route would change accounts of Eurasian technical exchange and give related translations and contacts a clearer chronology.

plague-disappearance.reason: Cross-port contrasts and policy changes can test quarantine effects, but simultaneous changes in trade, exposure and ecology leave broad causal attribution uncertain. A convincing explanation would change accounts of European mortality decline and sharpen comparative histories of epidemic control.

anonymous-serials.reason: A reprint under a woman's name can be checked against correspondence, payment records or an independently credited collection to avoid circular attribution. Restoring authorship would change some writers' bibliographies and open unsigned newspaper fiction to broader literary and network studies.

proto-elamite.reason: Administrative recurrence permits structural comparison, yet neither linguistic encoding nor descent follows from shared shapes or accounting conventions. Establishing both relationships would place early Iranian writing in a firmer history and guide interpretation of a large tablet corpus.

anonymous-imprints.reason: Distinctive combinations of damaged ornaments and type in securely dated signed books can identify workshops, with repeated matches helping to track transferred stock. Credible attributions would revise accounts of clandestine and ordinary printing and connect dispersed editions to printers and networks.
